name: OneLake catalog security management experience
description: Today Fabric has many different UI experiences for managing permissions to data: the share dialog, the manage permissions page, workspace role settings, and other in-artifact code or role creation experiences. With the OneLake catalog secure tab, you can now manage all your OneLake security roles from a single location. Users can also view user access to workspaces, items, and domains to get an end-to-end picture of data access in Fabric.
